schema.name: account_assignments
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE account_assignments (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	account_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	person_id VARCHAR(36), 
	status VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME, 
	ended_at DATETIME, 
	first_seen_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ingest_eligible BOOLEAN DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_account_assignments_id CHECK (length(id) = 36 AND id = lower(id) AND id GLOB '[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-4[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[89ab][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_account_assignments_kind CHECK (kind IN ('person', 'yuki')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_account_assignments_owner CHECK ((kind='person' AND person_id IS NOT NULL) OR (kind='yuki' AND person_id IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_account_assignments_status CHECK (status IN ('active', 'disabled', 'ended')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_account_assignments_revision CHECK (revision >= 1), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(person_id) REFERENCES persons (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

schema.name: accounts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE accounts (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	platform VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	external_account_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_accounts_native_key UNIQUE (platform, external_account_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_accounts_id CHECK (length(id) = 36 AND id = lower(id) AND id GLOB '[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-4[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[89ab][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_accounts_platform CHECK (length(platform) > 0 AND length(platform) <= 32 AND platform = lower(platform) AND platform = trim(platform)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_accounts_native_id CHECK (length(external_account_id) > 0 AND length(external_account_id) <= 255 AND external_account_id = trim(external_account_id))
)

schema.name: canonical_event_receipts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE canonical_event_receipts (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ingress_account_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	transport_namespace VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	ingress_presence_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	ingress_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	canonical_event_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	observed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_canonical_event_receipts_transport UNIQUE (ingress_account_id, transport_namespace, event_type, ingress_key), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_canonical_event_receipts_ingress_presence FOREIGN KEY(ingress_presence_id) REFERENCES account_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_canonical_event_receipts_ingress_presence_id CHECK (length(ingress_presence_id) = 36 AND ingress_presence_id = lower(ingress_presence_id) AND ingress_presence_id GLOB '[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-4[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[89ab][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_canonical_event_receipts_event_type CHECK (length(event_type) > 0 AND length(event_type) <= 64 AND event_type = trim(event_type)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_canonical_event_receipts_canonical_event_id CHECK (length(canonical_event_id) = 36 AND canonical_event_id = lower(canonical_event_id) AND canonical_event_id GLOB '[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-4[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[89ab][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]'), 
	FOREIGN KEY(ingress_account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

schema.name: chat_events
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE chat_events (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, 
	bot_user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	origin_key VARCHAR, 
	native_message_id VARCHAR, 
	scope_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	group_id VARCHAR(64), 
	private_peer_user_id VARCHAR(64), 
	sender_user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	sender_nickname VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	sender_group_card VARCHAR(128) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	direction VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	event_kind VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'message' NOT NULL, 
	source_plugin_id VARCHAR(128), 
	external_source VARCHAR(64), 
	external_event_key VARCHAR(255), 
	external_event_type VARCHAR(128), 
	external_resume_wait BOOLEAN DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	external_payload_json TEXT, 
	external_target_id VARCHAR(64), 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	visual_summary TEXT NOT NULL, 
	audio_transcript TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	segments_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	reply_to_message_id VARCHAR(128), 
	reply_to_event_id INTEGER, 
	origin VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	automation_id INTEGER, 
	automation_run_id INTEGER, 
	occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	observed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	canonical_event_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	canonical_conversation_id VARCHAR(36), 
	author_account_id VARCHAR(36), 
	author_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	author_person_id VARCHAR(36), 
	author_presence_id VARCHAR(36), 
	ingress_presence_id VARCHAR(36), 
	utterance_fingerprint VARCHAR(64), 
	suppression_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	ingress_provider VARCHAR(32), 
	ingress_gateway_instance_id VARCHAR(128), 
	caused_by_event_id INTEGER, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chat_events_kind_payload CHECK ((event_kind = 'message' AND source_plugin_id IS NULL AND external_source IS NULL AND external_event_key IS NULL AND external_event_type IS NULL AND external_payload_json IS NULL AND external_target_id IS NULL) OR (event_kind = 'external_event' AND source_plugin_id IS NOT NULL AND external_source IS NOT NULL AND external_event_key IS NOT NULL AND external_event_type IS NOT NULL AND external_payload_json IS NOT NULL AND external_target_id IS NOT NULL AND origin = 'plugin_background' AND direction = 'external')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chat_events_author_kind CHECK (author_kind IN ('person', 'yuki', 'external_bot', 'system', 'account')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chat_events_canonical_event_id CHECK (length(canonical_event_id) = 36 AND canonical_event_id = lower(canonical_event_id) AND canonical_event_id GLOB '[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-4[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[89ab][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]-[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chat_events_author CHECK ((author_kind = 'account' AND author_account_id IS NOT NULL AND author_person_id IS NULL AND author_presence_id IS NULL) OR (author_kind = 'person' AND author_person_id IS NOT NULL AND author_presence_id IS NULL AND author_account_id IS NULL) OR (author_kind = 'yuki' AND author_person_id IS NULL AND author_presence_id IS NOT NULL AND author_account_id IS NULL) OR (author_kind IN ('external_bot', 'system') AND author_person_id IS NULL AND author_presence_id IS NULL AND author_account_id IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chat_events_conversation CHECK (canonical_conversation_id IS NOT NULL OR (author_kind = 'account' AND scope_type = 'private' AND direction = 'inbound')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chat_events_suppression_status CHECK (suppression_status IN ('keeper', 'duplicate')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_chat_events_duplicate_fingerprint CHECK (suppression_status != 'duplicate' OR utterance_fingerprint IS NOT NULL), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reply_to_event_id) REFERENCES chat_events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(automation_id) REFERENCES automations (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(automation_run_id) REFERENCES automation_runs (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(canonical_conversation_id) REFERENCES canonical_conversations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(author_account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(author_person_id) REFERENCES persons (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(author_presence_id) REFERENCES account_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(ingress_presence_id) REFERENCES account_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(caused_by_event_id) REFERENCES chat_events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT
)
